clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Madame Eva spins Ghost Hair Thread from the spirit world. Its occult powers can bind spirits or stitch life into inanimate things. Abercrombie asks for it to ward his shack against restless ghosts.

Madame Eva spins Ghost Hair Thread in Darkshire, where its strange powers are known. Eva says the spectral strand can bind malevolent spirits or stitch vitality into inanimate objects. In Duskwood, it can be used in rituals and wards.
